data.title: 鸣濑白羽 · 更衣室柜门后的无声缠绵
data.description: 体育馆幽暗的更衣柜狭缝中，水手裙被径直掀起堆叠在小腹。为了不被外面的巡查人员发现，白羽死死捂住自己的嘴唇，在猛烈的侵入下眼角渗出了甜腻的泪水。
data.location: shadowed narrow space between tall steel school lockers in an empty gym
data.action: pressed back into metal locker alcove with sailor skirt hitched high, hand clamped tightly over her own mouth to stifle moans of intense ecstasy
data.lighting: slanted dusty sunbeams through high transom windows highlighting tear tracks on flushed cheeks
data.mood: illicit heart-racing tension, stolen schoolhouse pleasure, intense breathless thrill
